# Test archives (not shipped in the app)

Real archives made by other tools, so the tests don't only read AnySave's own output.

| Files | Made by | From | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `*.rar` | WinRAR / rar (RAR 2.9 and RAR5, locked, header-locked, solid, split, Unicode, a symlink traversal attack) | [markokr/rarfile](https://github.com/markokr/rarfile) `test/files` | ISC (Marko Kreen) |
| `t2.7z`, `t3.7z`, `t4.7z`, `lzma2.7z`, `multi.7z.001`–`006` | 7-Zip (password `password` for t2–t4) | [bodgit/sevenzip](https://github.com/bodgit/sevenzip) `testdata` | BSD-3-Clause (Matt Dainty) |

The RAR passwords are `password`.
